scope: Independent CI verification of Citus runtime and tenant database execution

requirements.citus-runtime: Consumer-owned floor of invoice immutability and workflow invocation persistence files
requirements.temporal-database: Consumer-owned six-file floor plus tracked Temporal database candidates

limitations: CLI fixture reports exercise gate behavior, not database operations.
Workflow retains path triggers; this is not a globally required check for every PR.
Native CI execution and effective branch protection are unverified.
Single-node runtime coverage does not prove supported-release or multi-node upgrades.
